sentences.text:
This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989.

Appellant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.724/2024 registered at Police Station Gorakhpur, District-Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N), 506 of IPC,
Section 3(2)(V), 3(1)(w)
(ii) of SC/ST Act.
Appellant is in jail since 19.09.2024 3.
Prosecution story, in brief, is that appellant repeatedly established physical relation with prosecutrix, aged 27 years without her consent.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that prosecutrix is married lady, aged 27 years having two children.
It is a case of consensual relationship.
Incident is said to have occurred from 10.04.2024 to 13.09.2024.
FIR has been lodged on 18.09.2024.
There is delay in lodging FIR for which no explanation has been furnished.
No injury has been found on the person of prosecutrix.
Learned counsel for the appellant has referred to written application submitted by the prosecutrix as well as her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS.

sentences.text: The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the appellant be released on bail pending the trial.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail 6.

Looking to the written application submitted by the prosecutrix as well as her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Consequently, this appeal stands allowed.

7. It is directed that appellant-Raghuvanshi Gupta be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
